name: Godfred Bokpin: taxation of high-net-worth individuals (Feb 2025)
detail: Called for a GRA policy on taxing high-net-worth individuals (income and compliance), not a tax on net wealth. Separate qualifying evidence is on his actor row.

name: Tax Justice Coalition Ghana
detail: Favours "direct taxes on incomes, wealth and property" and property tax over consumption taxes; its August 2026 line is better compliance, not new taxes. No wealth-tax call found.

name: Vitus Azeem
detail: Urged priority for property tax collection (Jan 2022); property tax only.

name: Daniel Domelevo (source-of-wealth law)
detail: Asks for a law on unexplained wealth, an anti-corruption measure, not a tax on wealth.

name: Ken Ofori-Atta: 2018 high net worth income tax
detail: A 35% income-tax band on earnings above GHc10,000 a month, an income tax.

name: Oxfam, SEND-Ghana and Ghana Anti-Corruption Coalition: Building a More Equal Ghana (2019)
detail: Press coverage shows only a call for progressive revenue and a higher share of direct taxes; the report itself could not be read (Oxfam page returned nothing).

name: Peter Quartey (ISSER)
detail: Told government to tax the rich by scaling up property-rate collection; property tax only.

name: ISSER mid-year review: income redistribution
detail: Recommends better policies to redistribute income; no tax on wealth named.

name: Johnson Asiedu Nketia (NDC)
detail: Says NDC believes in taxation for redistribution of wealth; generic, no wealth tax named.

name: NDC 2024 manifesto (Resetting Ghana, abridged)
detail: Text searched for wealth tax, net wealth, high net, super-rich, inheritance: no match. Mahama 2024 campaign document likewise.

name: CPP 2024 manifesto
detail: Full text searched (wealth tax, net wealth, billionaire, super-rich): only headings Inheritance Tax and Property Tax, both with no content; the tax plan favours income tax and cutting VAT.

name: Ghana inputs to the UN tax convention process (2024, 2025)
detail: Texts searched for wealth tax, high-net-worth, billionaire, net wealth: no match. Ghana backs the UN framework convention on tax cooperation, not a wealth tax.
